question: Who among the following became the youngest Member of Parliament in the 17th Lok Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandrani Murmu.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Chandrani Murmu **__became the youngest Member of Parliament in the 17th Lok

 Sabha.
 
• She was elected to the Lok Sabha from Keonjhar, Odisha in the 2019 Indian general election as a member of the Biju Janata Dal..
 
• She succeeded Sakuntala Laguri.
 
• Lok Sabha 
 __
 
• It is also known as Lower House.
 
• It was duly constituted for the first time on 17 April 1952.
 
• As per the Constitution of India, the maximum strength of the House is 552.
 
• Article 84 of the Indian Constitution sets qualifications for being a member of the Lok Sabha.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tejasvi Surya **is an Indian politician and lawyer serving as the Member of Parliament in the 17th Lok Sabha from the Bharatiya Janata Party, representing the Bangalore South constituency. 
 
• **Gaurav Gogoi **is an Indian politician of the Indian National Congress from the Indian state of Assam.
 
• **Nusrat Jahan i**s elected as a Member of Parliament, Lok Sabha from Basirhat constituency as a Trinamool Congress candidate.
